title: Dead code: duplicate bounds check in _coap_oscore_status
description:
**File:** python/src/lichen/schc/headers.py
**Lines:** 180-182

**Issue:** Lines 180-182 check `if offset + length > len(coap): return False` but this condition is already checked at lines 172-173 which returns `None`. The code at 180-182 is unreachable.

**Evidence:** The loop body parses delta (lines 143-154) and length (lines 157-168), each incrementing `offset`. Then line 170 updates `option_number += delta`. Lines 172-173 check `if offset + length > len(coap): return None`. If this passes, we reach 175-178. Then line 183 does `offset += length`. The check at 180-182 can never trigger because 172-173 already covers it.

**Fix:** Remove lines 180-182 entirely.
